hero.title: Stop guessing <hl>what to build.</hl>
hero.subtitle: People post the problems they want an app for. Everyone upvotes the ones they share. Builders ship solutions and compete on the same problem.

how.title: How it works
how.step1Body: "I want an app that…" Describe what's missing in your day.
how.step2Body: The issues most people care about rise to the top.
how.step3Body: Developers ship solutions. Users vote for the best one.

home.topSubtitle: Upvote the ones you'd use. Builders are watching.
home.builderBody: Pick a problem people already asked for, ship it, and get your first users on day one.
home.postTitle: What app do you wish existed?

issues.title: Issues
issues.subtitle: Problems people want an app for. Upvote what you share.
issues.emptyCta: Be the first to post one

issue.notFound: This issue doesn't exist (or was removed).
issue.buildingHint: Let people know you're on it. You can submit your solution when it's ready.
issue.noSolutions: No solutions yet. Could be yours.

newIssue.title: Post a problem
newIssue.subtitle: Describe the app you wish existed. Keep it about the problem, not the solution.
newIssue.bodyPlaceholder: Who has this problem? When does it happen? What do you do today?
newIssue.cooldown: You just posted. You can post again in a few minutes.

solution.title: Submit your solution
solution.subtitle: Built something for this problem? Share it. People will vote for the best one.
solution.urlHint: Website, App Store or Play Store link. Must start with https://
solution.bodyPlaceholder: How does it solve the problem?
solution.already: You already submitted a solution to this issue.
solution.cooldown: You just submitted a solution. Try again in a couple of minutes.

signin.title: Sign in to BuildThis
signin.subtitle: Post problems, upvote, and ship solutions.
signin.terms: By continuing you agree to let us store your name and email to run your account.

me.title: My account
me.dangerBody: Removes your profile and sign-in. Your issues and solutions stay, shown as "Deleted user".
me.deleteConfirm: Delete your account? This can't be undone.
me.reauth: For security, sign in again, then delete your account.
